scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof, reproducible symbolic and high-precision corroboration, and documented literature comparisons. Historical priority and independent validation are not established.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-volume, linearly exchanging, well-mixed compartments; constant nonnegative first-order losses; positive fixed-time single-box impulse observation. No unequal-volume, nonlinear, spatially extended, or total-exposure optimization claim.
title: A sharp exchange-rate optimum for an unequal-loss two-box tracer
